reason: Terminal prompts: a bare python, sage, matlab or magma at the Terminal panel's own line opens that language's prompt in a session of its own. The CLI REPL's per-input step moves to src/repl-step.ts, shared by the CLI and the Terminal command worker; the worker gains the prompt loop (one input at a time asked of the page by a line request, its output sent in the order written by an out request) and the prompt's output sink.
